components.why: services/web/requirements.txt:1-4 declares Python dependencies; services/web/manage.py:1-3 imports the Flask application from the project package.

deployables.name: web
deployables.why: docker-compose.yml:3-14 declares service web, its build context, command, published port, and dependency.

deployables.name: db
deployables.why: docker-compose.yml:15-22 declares service db with image postgres:13 and persistent storage.

deployables.name: services/web
deployables.why: services/web/Dockerfile:2 declares a Python base image; lines 16-20 copy requirements and application source into the image; line 23 selects the entrypoint.

interfaces.name: app
interfaces.why: services/web/project/__init__.py:13 assigns Flask(__name__) to module-level variable app.
docker-compose.yml:9-10 maps host port 5001 to the web container's declared port 5000. The label names the container-side port.

capabilities.why: services/web/project/__init__.py:3-8 imports Flask; services/web/requirements.txt:1 declares Flask==2.3.2.
services/web/project/__init__.py:9 and 15 import and instantiate SQLAlchemy; services/web/requirements.txt:2 declares Flask-SQLAlchemy.

docker-compose.yml:15-22 declares a postgres:13 service; services/web/requirements.txt:4 declares psycopg2-binary; services/web/entrypoint.sh:3-12 has a PostgreSQL readiness branch. The application config defaults to sqlite:// unless DATABASE_URL overrides it (services/web/project/config.py:8).

edges.why: docker-compose.yml:4-5 directly sets service web's build context to ./services/web, matching the component root.
docker-compose.yml:4-5 makes the services/web component the path referenced by the web deployable's build context.
docker-compose.yml:13-14 declares web depends_on db. This records the declaration only.
services/web/project/__init__.py:13 declares the module-level Flask application object in the component source.
docker-compose.yml:9-10 declares the web service port mapping 5001:5000.
services/web/project/__init__.py:3-8 imports Flask and services/web/requirements.txt:1 declares the dependency.

services/web/requirements.txt:4 declares the PostgreSQL driver and services/web/entrypoint.sh:3-12 checks PostgreSQL readiness conditionally; config.py:8 defaults to sqlite://, so this is support evidence, not a claim that this configuration selects PostgreSQL.

components.why: The oracle establishes the services/web Python project from its dependency manifest and launcher. Other project declarations elsewhere in the repository were outside the oracle.

deployables.why: The oracle establishes two Compose services and one Dockerfile build. Other deployment definitions are outside the oracle.

interfaces.why: The oracle establishes one module-level Flask application and the container-side port in the Compose mapping. Other interface declarations are outside the oracle.

capabilities.why: The oracle establishes selected framework, ORM, and conditional PostgreSQL evidence from imports, dependencies, config, and entrypoint. This is not an exhaustive inventory of code or configuration capabilities.

edges.why: Only relationships directly supported by the bounded oracle files are labeled; declarations elsewhere may add relationships.

source_notes: Hand labels were derived from the exact upstream commit named above. Evidence paths are scan-relative upstream paths and line numbers refer to that commit. SHA256 values are over the exact raw file bytes. The oracle is deliberately bounded to oracle_files; no claim of repository-wide completeness is made.
